preconditions.description: The number of main courses k and total courses n must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(main_courses) == k and all(1 <= c <= n for c in main_courses)
preconditions.description: The main courses must be k distinct integers within the range of available courses.
The total number of dependencies across all courses must not exceed the specified limit.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_complete else True
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to complete the main courses, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == m and all(1 <= c <= n for c in result)
postconditions.description: The output must contain m distinct integers representing the order of courses to be passed.

postconditions.expression: all(c in main_courses for c in result)
postconditions.description: All main courses must be included in the output order.
